author: david6666666
body: For a request like quality="fast" this falls through to cache_dit=None, i.e. Cache-DiT disabled -- the slowest H3 path. Since  ast is a valid level in the shared protocol (DIFFUSION_QUALITY_LEVELS), a caller asking for the fastest tier silently gets the reference path instead. Suggest rejecting unsupported levels like high does without cache_dit, or mapping  ast to an actual accelerated profile; at minimum log a warning so this isn't silent.

author: david6666666
body:
Small consistency nit: every sibling field above only overrides when explicitly provided (provided_fields), but this always assigns. Harmless today since the default is None, but it would silently clobber a model-set default quality if one is ever introduced. Mind gating it like 
um_inference_steps for symmetry.

author: david6666666
body: Same as the sync path: unconditional assignment while sibling fields are gated on provided_fields. Fine today (None default), but a future model default quality would be silently overwritten. Consider gating for consistency.
